LESSON: BREEDS OF LIVESTOCK ● CATTLE ● PIGS ● RABBITS ● SHEEP ● GOATS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Animal Production
Topic 2.1: Breeds of Livestock ● Cattle ● Pigs ● Rabbits ● Sheep ● Goats
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Breeds of Livestock ● Cattle ● Pigs ● Rabbits ● Sheep ● Goats, part of Animal Production in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How do livestock breeds affect productivity of animals? 2. How does animal production sector contribute to the country’s economy?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe breeds of livestock based on their uses,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Breeds of Livestock ● Cattle ● Pigs ● Rabbits ● Sheep ● Goats together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: learner appreciates the effort of others when discussing characteristics of various breeds of livestock.

● Respect: a learner accommodates each other’s ideas while discussing common breeds of livestock and their productivity.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Financial literacy: a learner appreciates the importance of investing in the animal production sector when discussing the

contribution of livestock in the country’s economy.

● Environmental Conservation: a learner appreciates how different breeds of livestock maintain biodiversity in our

environment and its associated benefits.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Digital devices with assistive technology

● Print materials

● Braille materials

● Live animals of different breeds

● Photographs/pictures of different livestock breeds in appropriate colour contrast

● Models of different livestock breeds

● Resource Person/farmer.

Suggested Key Skills

Distinguish common breeds of livestock based on their characteristics.
